pages.text: Parts are made at a crafting table from tempered ingots and flux. A part takes the worst star among its ingots.
pages.title: Parts

pages.text: An ingot and flux make an Armor Plate.
An ingot, flux and a nugget make four Rivets.
Two ingots and flux make eight Chain Links.
Weapon parts: an ingot and flux make a Blade; two ingots and flux an Axe Head.
